objective: Package website intelligence, evidence UX, ROI / Competitive, trace export, and governed write safety into a real consultant testing script.
goal: Five consultants test real unknown websites and score whether IDB identifies the business correctly, shows honest confidence, gives useful value guidance, and keeps writes safe.
pilotInstallUseSteps: Install or refresh the Intelligent Demo Builder Tampermonkey drawer in the consultant browser.
Open any NetSuite page in the approved demo account.
Open the IDB rail and clear the current session before each run.
Enter prospect name, website, conversation notes, and SC objective when available.
Review Plan, Review, ROI / Competitive, Run, and Trace before scoring.
Only test governed Customer + Proof Item write path when explicitly assigned; transaction writes remain blocked.
consultantTestingScript: Start from a real inbound prospect request.
Enter only the website and notes you would realistically have before a discovery or demo-prep conversation.
Do not correct IDB immediately unless it asks for confirmation.
Capture what IDB saw and why it classified the prospect.
Score whether the lane, proof anchor, product seed, product family, and demand moment are correct or honestly uncertain.
Review ROI / Competitive for usefulness and unsupported claims.
Export Trace JSON and reviewed packet before ending the run.
Record what felt wrong, slow, unclear, or impressive.

scorecardRubric.definition: Correct lane or honestly marked needs confirmation / insufficient evidence.
Names feel prospect-specific and website-grounded, not generic or embarrassing.
Proof anchor fits the prospect's business and website evidence.
Consultant can tell what IDB saw, why it decided, and what is uncertain.
ROI helps value selling without making unsupported savings claims.
Competitive guidance is useful without invented competitor facts.
Consultant can tell what can write, what is blocked, and why.
Consultant knows how to recover, reset, export trace, or add evidence.

go: 80%+ lane/proof selections are correct or honestly uncertain.
Consultants understand Review in under 30 seconds.
ROI / Competitive helps value selling without unsupported claims.
Reset and trace export work reliably.
noGo: Unknown websites regularly force wrong lanes.
Consultants cannot tell what will be written.
Unsupported ROI or competitor claims appear.
Any write occurs outside explicit governed flow.
